meta.source: tryplayground.com clone — 21 nav routes built and measured against the live original at 1440/768/390. Structure derived from src/App.jsx (route table), src/pages/* (template composition) and src/data/* (content modules).

categories.CHROME: Persistent site furniture rendered once by Layout.jsx and shared by every route.
categories.HERO: The above-the-fold opening block of a page: headline, subhead, primary CTA and any hero artwork.
categories.PROOF: Social-proof blocks — customer logos, testimonials, named quotes and review walls.
categories.FEATURE: Product-explanation blocks: alternating copy/media rows, capability cards and check-lists.
categories.COLLECTION: Repeating card grids and rails driven by a list in src/data — blog, webinars, resources, changelog, article rails.
categories.CONVERT: Blocks whose job is to move the visitor toward a demo: FAQ accordions, sibling-product links and closing CTA bands.

chrome.header.description: Sticky 78px nav bar with the announcement strip above it and the four hover mega-menus (Platform 667x381, Switch 620x370, Built for 881x271, Resources 683x320). Menu targets are the original's own measured hrefs.
chrome.header.scope: Every route, mounted once by Layout.jsx.

chrome.footer.description: Four-column link footer with the legal row beneath it.
chrome.footer.scope: Every route, mounted once by Layout.jsx.

chrome.scroll-restore.description: Resets scroll to top on navigation; a client router otherwise lands the visitor mid-page on the next route.
chrome.scroll-restore.scope: Every route, mounted once by Layout.jsx.

hero.home.description: Homepage hero: eyebrow pill, 68px H1, subhead, demo CTA, star rating, then the seven-tab product rail whose white thumb slides on cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) and auto-advances every ~4s over a 964x525 screenshot stage.
hero.home.scope: The homepage only — no other route carries the tab rail.

hero.split.description: Two-column inner-page hero: 68px H1, subhead and CTA on the left, a 409x547 product shot on the right, over a full-bleed illustration band.
hero.split.scope: The solutions and for-audience templates, which all measured this same split shape.

hero.centered.description: Centered hero: H1 and subhead on the cream field with no product shot, optionally over an illustration band or a row of photos.
hero.centered.scope: Support, customers, why-playground, about, careers, and the collection index pages.

proof.logo-ticker.description: Infinite partner-logo marquee running at a measured 49.7px/s, carrying the five real customer logos.
proof.logo-ticker.scope: Homepage plus every solutions, for-audience and support route; not on the collection indexes.

proof.testimonial-band.description: Named-customer quote beside a hand-drawn portrait inset in the 450x456 orange frame, with dot navigation between customers.

proof.review-wall.description: Grid of short unattributed platform reviews, with a Directors/Families tab pair on /about.
proof.review-wall.scope: /about and /careers, which share the same review set.

proof.customer-stories.description: Featured customer stories — portrait, quote and a stat block — followed by the shorter 'Wall of love' quote grid.

feature.intro-band.description: Centered band that opens a product page: 60px H2, a 17px sub-headline the original marks up as a second h2, and a row of capability labels.

feature.alternating-rows.description: Alternating copy/media rows — eyebrow, 48px H2, sub-headline, check-list and an optional pull quote, with the media column flipping side to side.

feature.card-grid.description: Grids of bordered 277x119 link cards, optionally over a row of product screenshots.
feature.card-grid.scope: /solutions/billing and /solutions/ai, the two hand-built solutions pages.

feature.grid-sections.description: Homepage product sections: centered eyebrow and H2 over a mixed-span card grid whose cards carry full-bleed artwork.
feature.grid-sections.scope: Homepage only — marketing, finances, operations and AI.

feature.timeline.description: Click-activated 30-day timeline: three day cards over a 966x275 growth-curve panel, with a dot and pill that slide along the curve on 500ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1).

feature.audience-tiles.description: Home-Based / Center / Multi-Location tiles, used both as a static row and as the selectable first step of the demo form.

feature.release-list.description: Compact version/title/date rows standing in for the changelog feed.
feature.release-list.scope: /support and /why-playground, as an inline proof of weekly shipping.

collection.card-grid.description: Grid of cover-plus-title cards driven by a list in src/data, with card geometry measured per page (343x205 landscape for webinars, 181x271 portrait for resources).

collection.category-feed.description: Posts grouped under category headings with a 'See all' link per group; capped at 8 posts per category and states the cap on the page.

collection.release-feed.description: Dated release entries with a 590x455 screenshot each; capped at the 24 most recent of 204 and states the cap.

collection.article-rail.description: Horizontally scrolling rail of 309x300 article cards. Its trailing cards sit ~3000px off-screen, so they only load once the rail itself is scrolled.

convert.faq.description: Question accordion. Rows toggle independently rather than single-open; whether row 1 ships open is measured per page and passed as openFirst.

convert.sibling-links.description: Cards linking to the other products in the same family, with the current page dropped from the list.

convert.closing-cta.description: Closing demo band: a 48px H3 and a primary CTA, sometimes over a full-bleed illustration.
convert.closing-cta.scope: 21 of the 23 routes. Absent on the 404, and on /why-playground, which ends on its FAQ because its demo CTA sits high up in the two-step form instead.

convert.demo-form.description: Two-step lead form: picking a program-type tile reveals a contact step, which on the original grows the page's text from 4,403 to 5,015 characters.

convert.not-found.description: 404 body: heading, explanation that the page may not be built in this clone, and a link home.
